## Definition of Done

- [ ] The need and the behaviour are documented.
- [ ] The code is reviewed and contains no secret.
- [ ] The relevant unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Existing connectors do not regress (Komga and Suwayomi journeys).
- [ ] Errors and loading states are handled.
- [ ] Accessibility and mobile use have been considered.
- [ ] The user or developer documentation is updated.
- [ ] Data migrations are tested, if needed.
- [ ] The feature has been checked on a clean Docker installation.
- [ ] Known limits are stated.
